## **Practical exercises**:

-  Download the shapefile of [Indice de Probreza Multidimensional (IPM)](https://dane.maps.arcgis.com/apps/MapJournal/index.html?appid=54595086fdd74) by DANE(2020)

-  Preprocess the shapefile to cover only your department

-  Add municipalities, population, roads, cities, and IPM layers to a new QGIS project

-  Define symbology for each layer (add labels as needed)

-  Make a map of IPM and colour print it 

**Make sure you upload the IPM map to the drive on 17th September**
